content:
Agreement with the instructor cannot be the entire outcome measure
A program could increase agreement with its preferred worldview through conformity while leaving general reasoning unchanged. Evaluate held-out factual accuracy, calibration, argument quality and practical decisions, with blinded assessment where feasible. A theological endpoint alone cannot identify the mechanism or establish broad rational improvement.

quote: all your students five years later, and see
content:
The proposed training program still needs a causal test
A multiyear curriculum evaluated against a comparison group is a testable proposal. Later evidence relevant to a much weaker intervention is sobering: Sanchez and colleagues failed to replicate the Thinker-picture prime’s reduction in religious belief, with N=941 and d=+0.07 versus the original −0.59. This later study was not cited by Yudkowsky and does not test five years of education.
Sanchez et al. (2017)

quote: we have a scientist who’s still religious,
content:
A false belief does not erase every instance of expertise
A scientist’s religious commitment can deserve criticism without proving that they understand no evidence, no Occam-style reasoning or no scientific method. People can compartmentalize and possess domain-specific competence. The categorical diagnosis is broader than the evidence supplied by a disputed belief.
